top_signal.title: Looking for Advice
top_signal.summary: I have been making a little money on the side for a few years now, doing historical costuming for friends in historical reenactment circles. Unfortunately, I've lost two jobs this year and I am in a position where I need buckle down and get this side venture to make me a little more money while I get through a bookkeeping certificate program. So I'm looking for advice from other small businesses, particularly businesses selling handmade items. I'm looking to really buckle down on this in the new year and I want to spend these last couple of months getting everything lined up for that.   Some questions I have:   If I file a DBA (doing business as), should I do that before I get my social media/website and such going, or can I wait? What are some pros and cons of waiting vs doing it immediately, and at what point so I Need to have that done?   Are there any good alternatives to Etsy? I'd like to avoid selling on Etsy, but I know I'll have to do a lot more work advertising.   What's the most economical option for a website? I have experience with Wix from a previous employer, and I briefly held a volunteer position that used wordpress and really struggled to understand how to use wordpress effectively. But what is my best option?    Are there any other recommendations, articles, etc that people can provide?
